recipes.title: Classic French Fresh Tarragon & Chive Soft Omelet
recipes.summary: Silky, tender French-style folded omelet perfumed with finely snipped fresh tarragon, chives, and mild olive oil.
steps: Whisk eggs with 1 tbsp water, snipped fresh tarragon, chives, and a pinch of salt and black pepper.
Warm olive oil in a small nonstick skillet over medium-low heat and pour in eggs.
Stir gently 1 minute, let softly set 2 minutes, fold tenderly in half, and slide onto a warm plate.
tips: Tarragon is the signature perfume of French fines herbes omelets—mild, sweet, and gently licorice-bright.
Cloud-soft and effortless to eat warm.

recipes.title: Creamy Ricotta, Golden Mushroom & Fresh Tarragon Toast
recipes.summary: Warm whole-grain toast layered with soft ricotta and olive-oil sautéed cremini mushrooms finished with fragrant chopped fresh tarragon.
steps: Saute sliced mushrooms in olive oil 5 minutes until golden, then stir in minced garlic and fresh tarragon off the heat.
Spread warm whole-grain toast generously with part-skim ricotta.
Pile the aromatic tarragon mushrooms atop the ricotta and serve immediately.
tips: Adding fresh tarragon off the burner keeps its sweet green flavor crisp and lively.
Mushrooms and fresh tarragon are a timeless French bistro pair.

recipes.title: Smashed Avocado, Lemon & Fresh Tarragon Egg Toast
recipes.summary: Whole-grain toast topped with lemony avocado mashed with tender fresh tarragon leaves and crowned with a soft-cooked egg.
steps: Mash ripe avocado with lemon juice, snipped fresh tarragon, and a pinch of salt.
Spread onto warm whole-grain toast.
Top with a soft-cooked egg and a tiny drop of extra-virgin olive oil.
tips: Fresh tarragon brings delicate anise-citrus brightness that makes simple avocado toast taste gourmet.
Kitchen shears snip delicate tarragon leaves effortlessly.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt, Sweet Strawberries & Fresh Tarragon Bowl
recipes.summary: Cool plain Greek yogurt layered with macerated strawberries, rolled oats, honey, and delicate ribbons of sweet fresh tarragon.

ingredient_details.item: very finely snipped fresh tarragon leaves

steps: Toss sliced strawberries with honey, fresh lemon juice, and finely snipped fresh tarragon; rest 3 minutes to turn juicy.
Spoon plain Greek yogurt into a chilled bowl.
Pile the fragrant tarragon strawberries and juices over the yogurt and top with toasted oats.
tips: French pastry chefs love pairing sweet strawberries with a light touch of fresh tarragon.
Ripe peaches or apricots taste equally lovely here.

recipes.title: Soft Asparagus, Goat Cheese & Fresh Tarragon Egg Skillet
recipes.summary: Springtime single-skillet soft eggs nestled with tender asparagus tips, olive oil, creamy goat cheese, and fresh tarragon.
steps: Steam-saute cut asparagus with olive oil and 2 tbsp water covered 4 minutes until bright green and tender.
Crack four eggs over the asparagus, cover, and cook gently 4 minutes until whites set.
Remove from heat and finish with soft goat cheese, fresh tarragon, and a light squeeze of lemon.
tips: Asparagus, eggs, and tarragon are a celebrated French spring trio—ready in one pan.
Substitute sweet green peas when asparagus is out of season.

recipes.title: French Bistro Fresh Tarragon & Grape Poached Chicken Salad
recipes.summary: Signature lightened tarragon chicken salad folding tender poached chicken, halved grapes, celery, Greek yogurt, Dijon, and abundant fresh tarragon.
steps: Whisk Greek yogurt, Dijon mustard, fresh lemon juice, chopped fresh tarragon, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Fold in tender diced poached chicken, halved grapes, and finely diced celery.
Serve on soft whole-grain bread or tender butter lettuce cups.
tips: Classic bistro tarragon chicken salad lightened seamlessly with plain Greek yogurt instead of mayonnaise.
Keeps 3 days chilled for effortless lunches.

recipes.title: Warm Baby Potato, Green Bean & Tarragon Vinaigrette Salad
recipes.summary: Mayo-free Parisian lunch salad tossing tender baby potatoes, crisp-tender green beans, and chickpeas in Dijon, olive oil, and fresh tarragon.

ingredient_details.item: white wine or apple cider vinegar

steps: Boil halved baby potatoes 8 minutes, add green beans to the pot for 5 minutes more until tender, and drain.
Whisk olive oil, vinegar, Dijon mustard, and chopped fresh tarragon in a bowl.
Toss warm potatoes, green beans, and chickpeas gently in the dressing and serve warm or room temperature.
tips: Warm potatoes soak up tangy Dijon-tarragon vinaigrette deeply without needing mayonnaise.
Completely plant-based and rich in fiber.

recipes.title: Velvety Sweet Carrot, Orange & Fresh Tarragon Soup
recipes.summary: Silky French-inspired carrot soup simmered with sweet onion and orange zest, finished off-heat with bright fresh tarragon and olive oil.

ingredient_details.item: fresh orange zest plus 2 tbsp juice

steps: Soften onion in olive oil 4 minutes, then add sliced carrots, vegetable broth, and half the tarragon; simmer 15 minutes until carrots are completely soft.
Remove from heat, add orange juice, orange zest, and remaining fresh tarragon, and blend silky smooth.
Ladle warm into bowls with a final tiny drizzle of olive oil.
tips: Carrots and fresh tarragon are a renowned classical pairing—sweet, velvety, and dairy-free.
Ultra-smooth texture glides down effortlessly.

recipes.title: Cool Poached Salmon, Cucumber & Tarragon Yogurt Bowl
recipes.summary: Tender flaked poached salmon, cool diced cucumber, cooked quinoa, and bright lemon-tarragon yogurt dressing in a calm midday bowl.
steps: Whisk Greek yogurt, olive oil, lemon juice, chopped fresh tarragon, and 1 tbsp water into a pourable herb dressing.
Arrange quinoa, diced cucumber, and moist flakes of poached salmon in two bowls.
Drizzle generously with the bright tarragon yogurt dressing.
tips: Fresh tarragon gives salmon the sophisticated brightness of bearnaise sauce without heavy butter.
Zero cooking needed using pre-poached salmon.

recipes.title: Smashed White Bean, Avocado & Fresh Tarragon Wrap
recipes.summary: No-cook plant-based wrap spreading creamy mashed cannellini beans and avocado accented with bright fresh tarragon, lemon, and baby spinach.
steps: Mash cannellini beans and ripe avocado smoothly with fresh lemon juice, chopped fresh tarragon, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Spread generously across two soft whole-wheat tortillas and layer with baby spinach.
Roll snugly and slice diagonally in half.
tips: Creamy, gentle, and packed with plant fiber and healthy monounsaturated fats.
Fresh tarragon makes simple mashed white beans taste crisp and springlike.

recipes.title: Lightened French Poulet a l'Estragon (Tarragon Braised Chicken)
recipes.summary: Beloved Parisian classic lightened with Greek yogurt instead of heavy cream: tender chicken thighs braised in lemon-garlic broth and abundant fresh tarragon.
steps: Brown chicken thighs lightly in 1 tbsp olive oil 3 minutes per side, then saute diced onion and garlic 2 minutes.
Add chicken broth and half the fresh tarragon; cover and simmer 11 minutes until chicken reaches 165 F.
Turn off the burner, swirl in Greek yogurt, lemon juice, and remaining fresh tarragon until silky, and spoon over chicken and rice.
tips: Turning off the stove before stirring in Greek yogurt keeps the French tarragon sauce completely smooth with zero curdling.
Serve with steamed green beans or mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Poached Cod in Sweet Pea, Lemon & Fresh Tarragon Broth
recipes.summary: Silky, tender cod fillets gently poached in fragrant vegetable broth with sweet green peas, lemon, olive oil, and generous fresh tarragon.
steps: Simmer vegetable broth, sliced garlic, and half the tarragon in a wide skillet 2 minutes.
Nestle cod fillets and green peas into the gentle broth, cover, and poach 8 minutes until fish flakes softly.
Plate into shallow bowls and finish with extra-virgin olive oil, fresh lemon juice, and remaining tarragon.
tips: Light, moist, and naturally gluten- and dairy-free.
Serve over soft baby potatoes or quick polenta to catch the fragrant broth.

recipes.title: Dijon, Lemon & Fresh Tarragon Baked Salmon with Asparagus
recipes.summary: Moist oven-baked salmon glazed lightly with Dijon mustard, olive oil, lemon, and abundant fresh tarragon alongside tender roasted asparagus.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; toss asparagus with 1 tbsp olive oil on one side of a parchment-lined pan and arrange salmon fillets on the other.
Whisk Dijon mustard, remaining olive oil, lemon juice, and half the tarragon and spread across the salmon.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes until salmon flakes gently and asparagus is tender, then shower with remaining fresh tarragon.
tips: Dijon mustard seals moisture into salmon and pairs naturally with sweet French tarragon.
One tray, 20 minutes, easy cleanup.

recipes.title: Velvety Ricotta, Golden Mushroom & Fresh Tarragon Pasta
recipes.summary: Short pasta folded with browned cremini mushrooms, garlic, silky ricotta-pasta-water sauce, baby spinach, and aromatic fresh tarragon.
steps: Boil short pasta per package instructions, reserving 1/2 cup starchy pasta water.
Meanwhile saute mushrooms in olive oil 6 minutes until browned, stirring in minced garlic for 45 seconds.
Turn off heat, toss hot pasta, baby spinach, ricotta, pasta water, and generous fresh tarragon together until glossy and velvety.
tips: Part-skim ricotta thinned with hot pasta water gives silky cream-sauce comfort with less saturated fat.
Short shells catch every bit of mushroom and fragrant tarragon cleanly.

recipes.title: Glazed Roasted Carrots, White Beans & Fresh Tarragon Bowl
recipes.summary: Caramelized honey-olive oil roasted carrots piled over warm brothy cannellini beans and baby spinach finished with fresh tarragon and lemon.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; toss carrots with olive oil and honey on a parchment-lined pan and roast 18 to 20 minutes until sweet and tender.
Warm cannellini beans with 1/4 cup water and baby spinach in a small saucepan 3 minutes until greens wilt.
Spoon creamy beans and spinach into bowls, top with roasted carrots, lemon juice, and abundant fresh tarragon.
tips: Sweet caramelized carrots and fresh tarragon create a memorable, comforting plant-based supper.
Sprinkle crumbled goat cheese or toasted walnuts on top if desired.

recipes.title: Sweet Strawberry, Greek Yogurt & Fresh Tarragon Smoothie
recipes.summary: Silky French-patisserie-inspired smoothie blending frozen strawberries, Greek yogurt, milk, honey, and delicate fresh tarragon leaves.
steps: Add milk, Greek yogurt, fresh tarragon leaves, frozen strawberries, and honey to a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until pastel pink, smooth, and delicately sweet-herbal.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Fresh tarragon has a gentle sweet-anise aroma that makes ripe strawberries taste even richer.
Start with 1 to 1 1/2 teaspoons of fresh leaves for a crisp, balanced finish.

recipes.title: Sunlit Peach, Vanilla & Fresh Tarragon Oat Smoothie
recipes.summary: Velvety dairy-free summer blend uniting frozen peaches, oat milk, pure vanilla, lemon juice, and fresh green tarragon.
steps: Combine oat milk, fresh tarragon leaves, frozen peaches, vanilla extract, and lemon juice in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until glowing golden and completely silky.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy immediately.
tips: Stone fruit like peaches and apricots are a dream match for sweet French tarragon.
Dairy-free, nut-free, and requires zero added sweetener.

recipes.title: Crisp Pear, Baby Spinach & Fresh Tarragon Green Smoothie
recipes.summary: Clean, refreshing emerald smoothie blending ripe pear, baby spinach, banana, fresh tarragon leaves, lime, and cold water.
steps: Blend cold water, baby spinach, and fresh tarragon leaves 20 seconds until completely liquefied.
Add diced ripe pear, frozen banana, and lime juice and blend 35 seconds until light and frothy.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Echoes refreshing Caucasian tarragon drinks in a fiber-rich green smoothie form.
Naturally hydrating and gentle on digestion.

recipes.title: Wild Blueberry, Rolled Oat & Fresh Tarragon Smoothie
recipes.summary: Antioxidant-rich morning smoothie pairing frozen blueberries, rolled oats, almond milk, banana, lemon zest, and fresh tarragon.
steps: Place almond milk, rolled oats, fresh tarragon leaves, frozen blueberries, banana, and lemon zest in a blender.
Blend on high 55 seconds until deep violet and velvety smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy chilled.
tips: Subtle sweet tarragon lifts dark berries without overpowering them.
Sustaining whole-grain breakfast with zero dairy.

recipes.title: Pineapple, Kefir & Fresh Tarragon Botanical Smoothie
recipes.summary: Bright probiotic smoothie blending plain kefir, sweet frozen pineapple, fresh tarragon leaves, lime juice, and honey.
steps: Combine plain kefir, fresh tarragon leaves, frozen pineapple, lime juice, and honey in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until airy, frosty yellow-green, and smooth.
Serve chilled immediately.
tips: Tangy kefir and sweet pineapple complement tarragon's fresh herbal sweetness wonderfully.
Omit honey if your pineapple is very sweet.

recipes.title: Georgian Tarkhun Fresh Tarragon & Lemon Sparkling Cooler
recipes.summary: Iconic Republic of Georgia emerald summer refresher blending fresh tarragon leaves with cold water, lemon juice, and honey, strained clear and topped with fizz.
steps: Blend fresh tarragon leaves, chilled water, fresh lemon juice, and honey 20 seconds until vivid green.
Strain through a fine-mesh sieve into two ice-filled glasses for a crystal-smooth emerald base.
Top with chilled sparkling water, stir lightly, and serve immediately.
tips: Tarkhun is Georgia's beloved national fresh tarragon lemonade—bright, cooling, and 100% natural without artificial dyes.
Use still cold water whenever you prefer a flat lemonade.

recipes.title: Crisp Cucumber, Green Apple & Fresh Tarragon Press
recipes.summary: Clean spa-green press blending chopped cucumber, pressed apple juice, fresh tarragon leaves, and lime, strained silky over ice.
steps: Blend chopped cucumber, apple juice, chilled water, fresh tarragon leaves, and lime juice 20 seconds.
Strain cleanly through a fine sieve over ice cubes.
Enjoy chilled and crisp.
tips: Crisp apple and cool cucumber showcase tarragon's sweet anise finish with zero added sugar.
No juicer needed.

recipes.title: Chilled Sweet Pear, Lemon & Fresh Tarragon Press
recipes.summary: Delicate pure pear juice briefly pulsed with fresh tarragon leaves and lemon juice, then strained smooth over ice.
steps: Pulse pure pear juice, chilled water, fresh tarragon leaves, and lemon juice 15 seconds.
Strain through a fine sieve into an ice-filled glass.
Sip cold right away.
tips: Pear and fresh tarragon taste softly floral and calm—ideal for an afternoon pause.
Caffeine-free and naturally sweet.

recipes.title: Golden Pineapple, Lime & Fresh Tarragon Cooler
recipes.summary: Sunny tropical juice pressing pure pineapple juice with fresh tarragon leaves, lime, and chilled water, strained frosty smooth.
steps: Pulse pineapple juice, chilled water, fresh tarragon leaves, and lime juice 15 seconds until lightly frothy.
Strain cleanly over a glass of ice cubes.
Enjoy crisp and chilled.
tips: Fresh tarragon turns familiar pineapple juice into a breezy botanical mocktail.
Splash with sparkling water if you want extra fizz.

recipes.title: Ruby Strawberry, Lemon & Fresh Tarragon Agua Fresca
recipes.summary: Bright coral berry cooler blending hulled strawberries, fresh tarragon leaves, lemon juice, honey, and chilled water, strained spotless.
steps: Blend strawberries, fresh tarragon leaves, chilled water, lemon juice, and honey 20 seconds.
Strain through a fine sieve into two ice-filled glasses.
Serve immediately.
tips: Straining removes strawberry seeds and herb flecks for an ultra-smooth jewel-bright sip.
Naturally hydrating and low in added sugar.

recipes.title: French Bistro Tarragon, Flaked Salmon, Celery & Olive Oil Eggs
recipes.summary: Classic French soft scrambled eggs gently cooked in olive oil with finely diced celery stalk, flaked poached salmon, black pepper, and fresh tarragon.
steps: Soften very finely diced celery stalk in olive oil over gentle heat 3 minutes.
Pour in whisked eggs and black pepper, folding slowly until soft velvety curds form.
Fold in flaked salmon and chopped fresh tarragon off the heat and serve warm.
tips: Fresh tarragon is the signature French herb for delicate morning eggs and fish.
Soft, creamy, and omega-3 rich.

recipes.title: Tender Tarragon, Thyme & Poached Chicken Soft Omelet
recipes.summary: Cloud-soft French-style omelet filled with warm shredded poached chicken, finely chopped fresh tarragon, thyme, black pepper, and sunflower oil.
steps: Whisk eggs with water, black pepper, thyme, and half the fresh tarragon.
Cook gently in sunflower oil over low-medium heat, pulling edges inward until just set and custardy.
Spoon warm shredded chicken and remaining fresh tarragon across the center and fold softly.
tips: Cooking over gentle heat avoids rubbery browned edges.
Soft and protein-rich start to the day.

recipes.title: Fresh Tarragon, Cantaloupe, Red Grape & Walnut Oil Ricotta Bowl
recipes.summary: Silky ricotta topped with ripe cantaloupe cubes, halved red grapes, finely chopped tarragon, black pepper, and cold-pressed walnut oil.
steps: Whip ricotta gently with a fork and divide between two morning bowls.
Top with ripe cantaloupe cubes, halved red grapes, and finely chopped fresh tarragon.
Add a whisper of black pepper and drizzle with cold-pressed walnut oil.
tips: Tarragon's subtle sweet anise note makes cantaloupe and grapes sparkle.
Zero cooking needed.

recipes.title: Warm Pearl Barley, Tarragon, Sweet Orange & Celery Cottage Bowl
recipes.summary: Gentle morning bowl combining warm pearl barley, finely diced celery stalk, bright orange segments, chopped fresh tarragon, flaxseed oil, and cottage cheese.
steps: Warm cooked pearl barley briefly with finely diced celery stalk and 2 tbsp water until tender.
Divide between two bowls alongside soft cottage cheese and sweet orange segments.
Scatter chopped fresh tarragon and orange zest, and drizzle with cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
tips: Balanced whole-grain protein breakfast with subtle sweet herbal lift.
Gentle chew throughout.

recipes.title: Sweet Tarragon, Dark Cherry, Blueberry & Olive Oil Yogurt
recipes.summary: Creamy Greek yogurt layered with quartered dark cherries, wild blueberries, finely snipped fresh tarragon, and fruity extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Spoon plain Greek yogurt into two bowls.
Arrange quartered dark cherries and fresh blueberries over top and scatter finely snipped fresh tarragon.
Finish with a delicate thread of fruity extra-virgin olive oil.
tips: Tarragon's delicate sweet fragrance pairs unexpectedly well with summer berries and cherries.
Effortless 5-minute breakfast.

recipes.title: Classic French Tarragon Chicken, Celery & Grape Walnut Oil Salad
recipes.summary: Beloved bistro lunch combining shredded poached chicken, finely diced celery stalk, halved red grapes, generous fresh tarragon, black pepper, and walnut oil.
steps: Whisk Greek yogurt, cold-pressed walnut oil, chopped fresh tarragon, and black pepper into a silky dressing.
Fold in shredded poached chicken, finely diced celery stalk, and halved red grapes.
Serve chilled over baby spinach or soft whole-grain bread.
tips: Generous fresh tarragon is what makes French chicken salad unforgettable.
Soft, creamy, and protein-rich.

recipes.title: Flaked Salmon, Fresh Tarragon, Orange & Pearl Barley Plate
recipes.summary: Bright coastal lunch uniting flaky poached salmon, cooled cooked pearl barley, sweet orange segments, chopped tarragon, black pepper, and extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Whisk extra-virgin olive oil, fresh orange juice, chopped tarragon, and black pepper.
Toss cooled pearl barley with the dressing and sweet orange segments.
Top gently with flaky poached salmon and serve cool.
tips: Zero cooking when using pre-poached salmon and cooked barley.
Bright, clean Mediterranean-French flavors.

recipes.title: Velvety Tarragon, Celery Stalk & White Bean Olive Oil Soup
recipes.summary: Smooth French-inspired puree simmering celery stalk, yellow potato, and creamy white beans with black pepper, olive oil, and generous fresh tarragon.
steps: Soften chopped celery stalk in 1 tbsp olive oil 4 minutes, then add diced potato, white beans, broth, and black pepper.
Simmer gently 12 minutes until completely soft, then fold in half the tarragon and blend silky smooth.
Ladle warm and garnish with remaining olive oil and fresh chopped tarragon.
tips: Adding half the tarragon off-heat keeps its emerald color and sweet aroma fresh.
Plant-protein rich and effortless to swallow.

recipes.title: Tarragon, Soft Chickpea, Raspberry & Pumpkin Seed Oil Salad
recipes.summary: Colorful midday salad combining soft chickpeas, finely diced celery stalk, fresh raspberries, chopped tarragon, sumac, and roasted pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Whisk roasted pumpkin seed oil, fresh orange juice, sumac, and chopped tarragon.
Fold in soft chickpeas, finely diced celery stalk, and fresh raspberries gently.
Serve chilled or room temperature.
tips: Tart raspberries and ruby sumac frame sweet fresh tarragon cleanly.
Zero stovetop heat.

recipes.title: Fresh Tarragon, Sweet Basil, Blueberry & Flax Oil Mozzarella Bowl
recipes.summary: Soft cool midday plate pairing fresh mozzarella pearls, ripe blueberries, torn sweet basil, chopped tarragon, black pepper, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
steps: Combine soft mozzarella pearls, fresh blueberries, torn sweet basil, and chopped fresh tarragon.
Drizzle with cold-pressed flaxseed oil and add freshly cracked black pepper.
Toss gently and enjoy immediately.
tips: Two gentle garden herbs lift soft mozzarella and sweet berries effortlessly.
Rich in plant omega-3s.

recipes.title: Gentle French Tarragon Chicken, Celery & Pearl Barley Fricassee
recipes.summary: Classic poulet a l'estragon made light—tender diced chicken gently simmered with celery stalk, pearl barley, thyme, generous fresh tarragon, and olive oil.
steps: Soften finely diced celery stalk and thyme in olive oil 4 minutes, then cook diced chicken with black pepper 5 minutes.
Add cooked barley, chicken broth, and half the tarragon; cover and simmer gently 8 minutes until tender.
Remove from heat and fold in Greek yogurt and remaining fresh tarragon for a silky light sauce.
tips: Stirring Greek yogurt in off the heat gives French fricassee velvet richness with zero heavy cream.
Timeless and gentle.

recipes.title: Poached Salmon with Fresh Tarragon, Saffron, Orange & Olive Oil
recipes.summary: Delicate salmon fillets gently poached in golden saffron-orange broth with thinly sliced celery stalk, extra-virgin olive oil, and generous fresh tarragon.
steps: Soften thinly sliced celery stalk in olive oil 3 minutes, then add broth, orange juice, and saffron threads.
Nestle salmon fillets in, cover, and gently poach 8 to 9 minutes until flaky.
Transfer to shallow bowls, spoon golden broth around, and scatter generous chopped fresh tarragon.
tips: Adding fresh tarragon at the table preserves its delicate sweet aroma.
Flaky and ultra-moist.

recipes.title: Delicate Tarragon, Fennel Seed & Celery Poached Cod with Walnut Oil
recipes.summary: Flaky white cod gently poached with celery stalk, lightly crushed fennel seed, and fresh tarragon, finished off-heat with cold-pressed walnut oil.
steps: Simmer thinly sliced celery stalk, crushed fennel seed, black pepper, and broth 5 minutes until celery softens.
Nestle cod fillets in, cover, and gently poach 7 minutes until flaky.
Plate warm, scatter fresh tarragon, and finish with cold-pressed walnut oil.
tips: Fennel seed gently echoes tarragon's sweet licorice-like warmth.
Effortless to chew.

recipes.title: Savory Ground Turkey, Dark Cherry, Tarragon & Summer Savory Bowl
recipes.summary: Tender crumbled turkey gently simmered with halved dark cherries, diced celery stalk, summer savory, fresh tarragon, and sunflower oil.
steps: Soften finely diced celery stalk and summer savory in sunflower oil 3 minutes, then cook finely crumbled turkey with black pepper 5 minutes.
Add broth and halved dark cherries, simmering gently 6 minutes until glossy.
Fold in fresh chopped tarragon off the heat and serve over warm pearl barley or mash.
tips: Fresh tarragon turns cherry-turkey pan sauce into a refined French-style comfort dish.
Soft texture throughout.

recipes.title: Golden Red Lentil, Butternut Squash, Tarragon & Olive Oil Stew
recipes.summary: Velvety plant-forward stew simmering red lentils and small-diced squash with turmeric, black pepper, olive oil, and bright fresh tarragon.
steps: Soften small-diced squash in 1 tbsp olive oil 3 minutes, then bloom turmeric and black pepper.
Add rinsed red lentils and broth; simmer gently 15 minutes until creamy and completely tender.
Fold in fresh chopped tarragon off the heat and finish bowls with remaining extra-virgin olive oil.
tips: Fresh tarragon brings bright springtime lift to warm golden lentils.
Spoonable and soothing.

recipes.title: French Garden Tarragon, Cantaloupe, Banana & Flaxseed Oil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Silky pastel-peach smoothie blending chilled cantaloupe, frozen banana, tender fresh tarragon leaves, oat milk, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
steps: Blend oat milk, chilled cantaloupe, frozen banana, and fresh tarragon leaves 45 seconds until silky.
Add cold-pressed flaxseed oil and pulse 3 seconds.
Pour chilled and enjoy immediately.
tips: Just 6 tender tarragon leaves give sweet melon-banana smoothies an elegant botanical perfume.
Soft, hydrating, and omega-3 rich.

recipes.title: Velvet Tarragon, Wild Blueberry, Red Grape & Olive Oil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Antioxidant purple smoothie blending wild blueberries, frozen red grapes, tender fresh tarragon, Greek yogurt, and mild olive oil.
steps: Blend cold water, Greek yogurt, frozen blueberries, frozen red grapes, and fresh tarragon leaves until completely smooth.
Add fruity olive oil and pulse 2 seconds.
Serve chilled right away.
tips: Tarragon brings subtle sweet herbaceousness that makes purple berries shine.
Refreshing and creamy.

recipes.title: Crisp Tarragon, Sweet Orange, Celery Stalk & Spearmint Smoothie
recipes.summary: Bright green-gold refresher combining peeled sweet orange, peeled celery stalk, fresh tarragon, cooling spearmint, and sunflower oil.
steps: Blend cold water, peeled sweet orange, chopped celery stalk, fresh tarragon, and spearmint 60 seconds until ultra-smooth.
Add cold-pressed sunflower oil and pulse 2 seconds.
Pour cold and serve right away.
tips: Sweet whole orange balances green celery and herbs effortlessly.
Zero added sugar.

recipes.title: Orchard Tarragon, Dark Cherry, Soft Barley & Walnut Oil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Velvety ruby-grain shake combining frozen dark cherries, chilled soft cooked barley, fresh tarragon leaves, oat milk, and cold-pressed walnut oil.
steps: Blend oat milk, frozen dark cherries, chilled soft barley, and fresh tarragon leaves 50 seconds until silky.
Add cold-pressed walnut oil and pulse 2 seconds.
Serve chilled immediately.
tips: Dark cherries and sweet tarragon make a wonderful gourmet-style smoothie.
Smooth whole-grain body.

recipes.title: Bright Tarragon, Raspberry, Lemon Balm & Ginger Smoothie
recipes.summary: Lively coral herb smoothie blending frozen raspberries, calming lemon balm, fresh tarragon, grated ginger, yogurt, and pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Blend cold water, Greek yogurt, frozen raspberries, fresh tarragon, lemon balm, and grated ginger until smooth.
Add pumpkin seed oil, pulse 2 seconds, and strain briefly if desired to catch raspberry seeds.
Pour chilled and enjoy immediately.
tips: Calming lemon balm and delicate tarragon tame tart raspberries cleanly.
Strain for silky sipping.

recipes.title: Georgian-Style Tarragon, Green Grape, Celery & Spearmint Press
recipes.summary: Inspired by classic Georgian Tarkhun—crisp emerald juice pressing sweet green grapes, fresh tarragon, celery stalk, and spearmint.
steps: Blend green grapes, chopped celery stalk, fresh tarragon leaves, spearmint, and cold water 35 seconds.
Strain cleanly through a fine-mesh sieve, pressing gently with a spoon.
Serve chilled right away.
tips: Fresh tarragon has been enjoyed in refreshing chilled drinks in Georgia for generations.
Crisp, vibrant, and naturally sweet.

recipes.title: Sunlit Tarragon, Sweet Orange, Cantaloupe & Sweet Basil Press
recipes.summary: Bright golden garden cooler pressing fresh orange juice, ripe cantaloupe, tender fresh tarragon, and sweet basil leaves.
steps: Blend fresh orange juice, cantaloupe cubes, fresh tarragon, and sweet basil 30 seconds.
Pass cleanly through a fine-mesh strainer into chilled glasses.
Serve cold immediately.
tips: Melon and sweet orange carry delicate tarragon effortlessly.
Zero added sweetener needed.

recipes.title: Chilled Tarragon, Blueberry, Lemon Balm & Black Tea Infusion
recipes.summary: Refreshing botanical iced tea uniting mild black tea with strained blueberry, fresh tarragon, and calming lemon balm.
steps: Blend fresh blueberries, orange juice, fresh tarragon, lemon balm, and 1/2 cup chilled black tea 30 seconds.
Strain cleanly through a fine sieve into remaining chilled mild black tea.
Stir gently and pour cold.
tips: Use decaf black tea for an uplifting evening herbal press.
Smooth and pulp-free.

recipes.title: Ruby Tarragon, Dark Cherry, Fresh Shiso & Ginger Tonic
recipes.summary: Lively ruby pressed juice combining pitted dark cherries, fresh tarragon, aromatic shiso, grated ginger, and chilled water.
steps: Blend pitted dark cherries, fresh tarragon, shiso leaves, grated ginger, and cold water 30 seconds.
Press smoothly through a fine-mesh strainer.
Serve chilled right away.
tips: Tarragon and shiso elevate sweet dark cherries into a crisp craft botanical drink.
Pure strained smoothness.

recipes.title: Silky Tarragon, Barley Water, Raspberry & Turmeric Cooler
recipes.summary: Soothing coral press combining chilled strained barley water, fresh raspberries, fresh tarragon, turmeric, and a tiny crack of black pepper.
steps: Blend raspberries, orange juice, fresh tarragon, turmeric, a tiny pinch of black pepper, and 1/2 cup chilled barley water 30 seconds.
Strain thoroughly through a fine-mesh sieve to remove seeds, then stir into remaining barley water.
Pour chilled and enjoy immediately.
